question: Select the incorrectly spelled word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1**' i.e. **'Juorney'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Juorney"** is an incorrect spelling. 
 
• The correct spelling is **"Journey"** (यात्रा).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Juorney'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Energetic" (ऊर्जावान), "Helpful" (सहायक), and "Possible" (संभावित) are all spelled correctly.
